DISCUSS: Denzel Aberdeen Cleared to Play for Florida Under Temporary Injunction
Denzel Aberdeen wins a temporary injunction allowing him to play for Florida in 2026–27. What the ruling means for the Gators and their backcourt.
https://www.gatorbaitmedia.com/post/denzel-aberdeen-florida-temporary-injunction-2026
By GatorBait Staff. Read it on GatorBait, then talk about it here. One thread per story; GatorBot posts the link, people post the takes.
